purpose: Spatial indexing for fast 3D region and radius queries.
description: Provides an Octree implementation for efficiently indexing and querying points in three-dimensional space.

Octree.luau.description: Maintains an octree of spatial nodes and supports nearest-neighbor and region queries.

OctreeNode.luau.description: Represents a point stored in an Octree.

OctreeRegionUtils.luau.description: Provides octree region and bounds calculations.
